title: Audit Google Ads Before You Change Anything
summary: Get a read-only audit of search terms, waste and weekly checks, then approve every change yourself so spend only moves when you say yes.

money_potential.label: Medium
money_potential.basis: Assumes you already run Google Search ads; the value is clearer audits and less unsupervised waste, not new demand.
money_potential.note: Value tiers are our rough estimates (labelled Estimate) of relative value to the business, each with its assumption. They are not promises, income claims or advice. Results depend on your market, offer and effort.

how_it_makes_money: Less wasted Search spend from clearer negatives and search-term reviews.
Weekly checks without handing the account keys to a bot.
who_its_for: Agencies that want draft audits before client changes.

stack.name: Google Ads Manager
stack.role: Audits search terms and negatives, suggests Search builds and weekly checks, and waits for your yes.
stack.creator: Dan

stack.name: Google Ads Performance Analyst
stack.role: Reviews accounts and campaigns and reports wasted spend and next fixes.
stack.creator: benln

stack.name: Google Ads Optimizer
stack.role: Runs a scheduled review that proposes changes toward your goal.
stack.creator: codyschneider

steps.name: Google Ads Manager
steps.does: Audits search terms and drafts weekly checks

steps.name: Google Ads Performance Analyst
steps.does: Reports wasted spend and next fixes

outputs: A waste list you can act on

steps: Run an audit on one campaign.
Compare the waste list with the performance report.
Approve only the changes you agree with.
guardrails: Keep change rights off until you trust the drafts.
Set a firm budget limit in Google Ads itself.
